description: Baker Hughes Company is an energy technology company with a diversified portfolio of technologies and services that span the energy and industrial value chain. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, its innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, and it is well positioned to deliver solutions across industrial and energy markets that make energy safer, cleaner and more efficient, with health, safety and environment integrated into everything it does. It organizes its business into two operating segments based on the focus of its markets and on customers' buying priorities, selling through direct and indirect channels with a direct sales force that has a strong regional focus and is supported by centers of excellence in each major product line, and its Oilfield Services and Equipment segment designs and manufactures products and provides related services and integrated solutions.
